card.name: Single agent versus combination therapy wording
card.fires_on: Words in oncology label text where a brand drug is said to be given as a single agent, alone or as monotherapy, especially the 'or' / 'in' before 'combination with', and the end of the brand name just before it.

modes.label: Before 'combination'
modes.description: The 'or' or 'in' right after 'single agent' or 'alone', leading into 'in combination with'.
modes.example: hemorrhagic events of any grade occurred in 29% of the 799 patients treated with LENVIMA as a single agent<< or>> in combination with everolimus.

modes.label: End of brand name
modes.description: The last piece of a brand drug name that is followed by 'as a single agent' or 'monotherapy'.
modes.example: First-line metastatic NSCLC for treatment with TECENTRI<<Q>> as a single agent based on the PD

card.writes: It pushes the model toward 'associated' and related words, though the link to this pattern is weak.
card.plain: It lights up where a label says a drug is used alone or together with another drug.
